system.description:
You channel all your stored energy into your flail before striking out with the force of a meteor. Make a melee Taijutsu attack dealing you [Weapons damage] + 8d6. The affected creature must make a Strength Saving throw, being knocked Prone and Restrained into the ground until the start of their next turn.

Chain 2: You can make an additional attack but must target a different creature.

Chain 3: This jutsu’s attack gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range. If it scores a critical hit, you regain the Chakra spent to cast it.
